decisions.reason: As a core sensing module it still fits the platform and surviving beyond the initial launch period suggests performance around aspiration, but the earlier withdrawal of a related environmental sensor keeps some risk that resources are better redeployed if demand stays niche.

Because it is a next-generation replacement in an established voltage-measurement line, management would see it as meeting aspiration relative to proven internal benchmarks and would be very unlikely to discontinue it soon.

The MQTT proxy complements the modular hardware ecosystem at low carrying cost, so boundedly rational management would keep it while adoption remains uncertain, though it could still be dropped or folded into other software if usage falls below aspiration.
